name: 暗影步
description: 标记7格内1个空地格，下回合开始时传送到该位置。
code: function executeSkill(context) { const sourcePiece = context.piece; const targetPosition = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 7, filter: 'all' }); if (!targetPosition || targetPosition.needsTargetSelection) return targetPosition; const tile = battle.map.tiles.find(function(item) { return item.x === targetPosition.x && item.y === targetPosition.y; }); if (!tile || !tile.props.walkable) return { message: '目标位置不可行走', success: false }; const occupied = battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.x === targetPosition.x && piece.y === targetPosition.y && piece.currentHp > 0; }); if (occupied) return { message: '目标位置已被占用', success: false }; if (!sourcePiece.statusTags) sourcePiece.statusTags = []; if (!battle.extensions) battle.extensions = {}; if (!battle.extensions.tileEffects) battle.extensions.tileEffects = []; const sourceId = 'shadow-step-' + sourcePiece.instanceId; const existing = sourcePiece.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'shadow-step'; }); if (existing) { battle.extensions.tileEffects = battle.extensions.tileEffects.filter(function(effect) { return !(effect.tileType === 'shadow-step' && effect.sourceId === sourceId); }); existing.value = targetPosition.x; existing.intensity = targetPosition.y; existing.remainingDuration = 2; } else { sourcePiece.statusTags.push({ id: 'shadow-step-' + Date.now(), type: 'shadow-step', name: '暗影步', remainingDuration: 2, value: targetPosition.x, intensity: targetPosition.y, relatedRules: ['rule-shadow-step'] }); } battle.extensions.tileEffects.push({ x: targetPosition.x, y: targetPosition.y, sourceId: sourceId, tileType: 'shadow-step', icon: '👁', bgColor: 'rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.12)', boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.65)', iconPosition: 'top-left' }); if (!sourcePiece.rules || !sourcePiece.rules.some(function(rule) { return rule.id === 'rule-shadow-step'; })) addRuleById(sourcePiece.instanceId, 'rule-shadow-step'); return { success: true, message: sourcePiece.name + '标记了暗影步位置，将在下回合开始时传送到(' + targetPosition.x + ',' + targetPosition.y + ')' }; }
